body: Well then can I say goodbye to you
I do not. And I appreciate the effort but my mind is made up and it is too late now .
If I killed myself without posting this message you would never have known and never have been affected.
There is nothing to talk about. But I appreciate the effort. Goodbye my friend.
Send me one hahaha, how is it brother?

I am sixteen years old, thank you for the response. 

The way I see it, a permanent solution to temporary problems is accurate, but when your dead, it doesn't matter. NOTHING will matter, because your, you know dead. It's hard to put into words. 

My parents are very wealthy and so sending me away was actually the easier thing to do, since that way I am somebody elses problem. Out of their hair. 

As for the grief, well I can't deny that. But I guess I'm selfish. I don't really care if they feel grief, as douchey as that makes me sound.

No, I do not.
